title: Shared error and version helpers preserve approved semantics
statement: The shared DetranError and version helpers MUST preserve the approved CTG-0001 section 1 semantics: stable code/status and prefix-derived messageKey; assertIfMatch rejects absent, empty or malformed versions with <PREFIX>.IF_MATCH_REQUIRED/428, rejects a differing version with <PREFIX>.VERSION_CONFLICT/412 and expected version, accepts the approved matching version representations, and etagOf emits a quoted version.

strategy.rationale: The complete existing scoped suites exercise the approved positive and negative semantics; exact native producer custody remains independently required.
